verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's built-in Swarm tool orchestrates many sub-agents from a Code Mode script, with bounded fan-out, structured results, and live progress. That lets work be fanned out across many items at once, and sub-agents add parallel background runs. However, this is general parallel orchestration rather than a documented bulk-operation feature for acting on many items, such as batch edits or bulk messages. missing for 10: documented bulk/batch operations over specific item sets (selection, apply-to-all, per-item error handling), examples of bulk actions on real items, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
